name: Corporate Action Entitlement
definition: Rights entitled to the account owner based on the terms of the corporate action event and the balance of underlying securities.

EligibleBalanceIndicator.name: Eligible Balance Indicator
EligibleBalanceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the eligible balance is final except for a voluntary corporate action event where it can represent the current eligible balance when communicated before expiration date of that event.

EligibleBalance.name: Eligible Balance
EligibleBalance.definition: Total balance of securities eligible for this corporate action event. The entitlement calculation is based on this balance.

SecuritiesBalance.name: Securities Balance
SecuritiesBalance.definition: Specifies any type of balance related to a corporate action entitlement.

RelatedServicing.name: Related Servicing
RelatedServicing.definition: Process which groups the activities related to corporate action servicing.

NotEligibleBalance.name: Not Eligible Balance
NotEligibleBalance.definition: Total balance of securities which are not eligible for this corporate action event.
